description: Auto-arm WarmPulse heartbeat if ~/.claude/warmpulse.config.json sets auto_arm: true. Defaults to no-op if config absent or auto_arm is false.

hooks.command: if [[ -f "$HOME/.claude/warmpulse.config.json" ]] && grep -qE '"auto_arm"\s*:\s*true' "$HOME/.claude/warmpulse.config.json" ; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"WarmPulse auto-arm requested. Invoke /warmpulse to start the heartbeat Monitor."}}' ; else echo '{"continue":true}' ; fi
